methodology.scope: Research only. Production source, declarations, SDK, and configuration remained unchanged. All variants used task-owned copied declarations or temporary native binaries, directly in the primary checkout, without a worktree.
methodology.ablations: Removing binding/readonly/generic logic weakens the contract and is diagnostic only. Every raw exit status is retained. Costs interact and cannot be added or subtracted as independent stage times.
methodology.repeatTiming: Compiler and type-probe workloads ran sequentially; OS caches were not flushed. Current desktop hardware, not an isolated machine. Three samples per main compiler variant; exploratory cases mostly one sample.
methodology.statisticsCaveat: --extendedDiagnostics performs two explicit runtime.GC calls AFTER recording Total time. Diagnostic wall timings and profiles therefore include extra collection; reported Memory used is live Alloc after those collections, not peak RSS. Plain measurements exclude the flag.
methodology.control: Original installed RC6 binary copied beside prototype binaries, using the same standard-library directory; compare fresh processes. Plain and compiler-probe runs use the actual apps/example/tsconfig.json.
